errors.evidence: The figure contains three separate donut charts, not three concentric charts.
The description incorrectly states that the total number of enterprises is 19.0 million. This value (19.0 mln) corresponds only to the 'Other services' sector. The actual total is 31.0 million.

The absolute value for 'Other services' in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart is stated as 11.6 million, but the chart shows it is 19.0 million. The description seems to have incorrectly taken 19.0M as the total and calculated 61% of it.
The absolute value for 'Trade' in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart is stated as 3.6 million, but the chart shows it is 5.9 million.
The absolute value for 'Construction' in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart is stated as 2.3 million, but the chart shows it is 3.7 million.
The absolute value for 'Industry' in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart is stated as 1.5 million, but the chart shows it is 2.4 million.
The description incorrectly states that the total number of persons employed is 80.2 million. This value corresponds only to the 'Other services' sector. The actual total is 156.1 million.
The absolute value for 'Other services' in the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart is stated as 40.9 million, but the chart shows it is 80.2 million.
The absolute value for 'Industry' in the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart is stated as 16.8 million, but the chart shows it is 33.0 million.
The absolute value for 'Trade' in the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart is stated as 15.2 million, but the chart shows it is 29.5 million.
The absolute value for 'Construction' in the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart is stated as 7.3 million, but the chart shows it is 13.4 million.
The total turnover is stated as 31.2 trillion, but the sum of the values in the chart (10.6 + 9.9 + 9.8 + 1.9) is 32.2 trillion.
The description specifies the unit for turnover as 'euros', but this unit is not mentioned anywhere in the chart image. The chart only uses the abbreviation 'tln'.

errors.text_span: като „Индустрия“ и „Други услуги“ са с по 31% (по 9,8 трлн. и 9,9 трлн. съответно), „Търговия“ — 33% (10,6 трлн.)
errors.evidence: The values for the 'Turnover' chart are incorrectly mapped. The chart shows: 'Industry' is 33% (10.6 tln), 'Other services' is 31% (9.8 tln), and 'Trade' is 31% (9.9 tln). The description swaps the values for 'Industry' and 'Trade' and misstates the values for 'Industry' and 'Other services'.
